# Native FP3K menu integration investigation

The requested direction is a native “3K 3:2” recording option with normal selection, an accurate indication of active mode, and automatic restoration of stock settings on exit. FP3K0.1 remains the current installed, tested prototype; no new UI code has been installed.

## Concrete stock entry points

The firmware retains RTTI names MenuItemMovieRecSize (C0742204) and UicGuiMenuMovieRecord (C0D196D8). MovieRecord registers the named widget MV_Resolution through C0560FB0 at C057A4A8..C057A4BC with selection callback C057A6A0. Matching unregister code is C057A550..C057A564 through C0561080. This is a native widget event path, separate from the display-shell overlay that previously caused GUI flicker.

C057A6A0 uses C06BD9E0 to map the widget selection, then dispatches the resulting enum through a settings object's virtual slot+0x13C, with r2=0. The concrete live settings-object vtable and ensuing mode restart still need resolution.

C06BD960 exposes two pairs at C2E401FC: (value0,index0), (value1,index1). C06BD9E0 calls the native generic reverse lookup C06CF5D8, which scans 8-byte pairs and returns zero for an unknown index. C00A81E8 uses C0742228's two 12-byte records: enum2=1920×1080, enum3=3840×2160; an unknown value enters an Invalid MovSize logging path. Therefore merely adding a third visual choice will not create a valid recording profile. Dynamic class override of the mapping provider has not been ruled out. The adapter from UI values0/1 to the separate internal size enums2/3 remains unresolved; these must not be conflated.

Disassembly and machine-readable map: analysis/firmware/menu-integration/. Static byte assertions verify both tables. No native UI simulation or camera test has yet exercised these entry points.

## Required behavior before a usable menu release

- A genuine third choice (or an explicit dedicated 3K toggle), with a private state that stock unknown-enum paths never consume.
- Native widget rendering and selection/readback kept consistent; accurate active-state indication without shell-layer redraws.
- Apply all18 F1 words only in the supported true24/12bitSSD/crop-off mode while idle, before acquisition reconfiguration. Restore all18 stock words through the same controlled transition on deselection or incompatible mode changes. Existing F1 is apply-only; it is not a live toggle implementation.
- Serialize against recording, settings changes and pipeline restarts. Guard failure must not leave the screen saying3K while the camera records stock UHD.
- Keep custom state out of persistent stock settings unless their storage and reset semantics are understood. Avoid a new numeric resolution value being written to unknown persistence paths.

## Startup improvement candidate

The tested AutoRun executes495 mem-set commands (triplicated writes),20 diagnostic saves,one echo and a5000ms sleep. Three minutes is a conservative user wait, not an observed sensor requirement. Upstream fpSup has a native file-backed payload loader using the camera file API (gyro/pgenload.S and logger.S pool_load), plus cache synchronization. That supports investigating a small guarded loader plus a binary payload instead of spelling out the full payload as shell writes. It does not establish our new loader's timing, media readiness or safety; guards and hash checks must remain and the faster path needs its own camera test. No shortening of the currently installed wait is authorized by these static findings.

## Upstream scope

https://github.com/ijigen/fpSup/blob/main/projects/ui-sup.md documents shell display support and a researched DrawingObserver registration at C0528300, but says its persistent marker is not implemented. It supplies useful display research, not a ready native resolution-menu extension. Native-menu work can be explored with RAM hooks; a flashed update is not a prerequisite established by this trace.

## Native resource structure and display-message encoding

New tools/inspect_uic_resources.py indexes 303,599 length-delimited big-endian NBU records from C18EB48C through C2D8CEF8. NBU header C18C0460, string-pool origin C18C0474; the pool end is header+12+big-endian length at header+16. Records carry big-endian tag/total size, including unaligned records. Candidate string references must not be treated as typed fields: numeric IDs can accidentally match strings. Stock NBS/NBU/NBT/NBV/NBM magic strings are present. The parser validates the whole stream boundary without edits. Resolution-reference candidates saved to firmware/menu-integration/resolution-resource-references.json.

The region C1A5C590..C1A792FB contains resolution-related controls. C1A7086B is a list-plugin record (tag10008,269 bytes); binding fields include TEXT/image/enabled keys to child template objects. C1A71357 and C1A713EB invoke controlAppVariable for MV_Resolution from controlValue. This identifies serialized list/control machinery; it does not establish the actual row-data source or a safe location for adding a third row. No resource patch has been built.

Resolved native resolution display method C05931D0 (function-pointer literals C2DEE9EC and C2DEF29C). It maps through C06BD988 using the same actual enum provider, then C0593F30 builds a 56-byte UI message via C055DD10: kind2, flags0, name pointer MV_Resolution, index at+0xC. C055E1E8 posts it to the native UI queue under its own lock. New verify_native_resolution_ui.py runs the real mapping and message creation, mocking memset/service/queue; three cases pass enum3→index0,2→1,4→2. This is a suitable index-encoding boundary for future private 3K selection, not proof enum4 is safe in the stock capture setting.
